contexts.text: The things which impede must be removed.
Communications are effected by removals Sad and troublesome things are removed in an instant.
The removal of the love of self and of the world. Signified, Explained. AC 2102.
In proportion as these are removed...
With these there is not the removal of these cupidities, but only their lulling...
Man now remote from this state.
To remove () = to separate. AC 4005.
How remote these senses appear from each other.
Believes that Hell is far remote from him.
In the same proportion the Spirits who are in worldly things are removed from man.
Those who have removed others [out of their way]. Described.
Causes of temptations proximate and remote.
Heaven then removes itself from them...
Those of the old Church, and thus remote from Heaven...
To remove () = to reject.
Falsities are then removed.
There is such a removal of Falsities from man's infancy to his last age... The regenerate regards those as remote from himself which... but the non-regenerate, those which...
When falsities are being removed with a regenerate man, they are rejected to the lowest of the Natural... Signified.
By temptations, evils and falsities when conquered are... rejected and removed. AC 5246:3, Explained.
To forget = removal; for, according to the non-conjunction, removal is effected: that which is given to oblivion, is also removed. AC 5278, Explained.
The removal of truth... in both Naturals. Signified, Explained.
Man cannot be regenerated until these loves have been removed; and in order that they may be removed, man is let into a state of temptation. Explained.
The removal of evils after temptations, Signified, Explained.
The removal of hereditary evils. Signified, Explained.

When evils have been removed, a new Voluntary arises... In miseries, the loves of self and the world are removed... in like manner in temptations... by which especially are evils removed; and, after these have been removed, celestial good inflows...
Disposition is effected by removal and concealment. Signified, Explained... Not that the Lord ever removes or hides mercy; but... the Lord then appears to be removed and hidden.
The external man, with its truths and scientifics, somewhat removed. Signified, Explained.
To remove () = to turn away.
The sceptre shall not be removed from Judah () = that the Power shall not recede...
They are infested by the evils and falsities with them, to the end that these may be removed. AC 6724:2. AC 7122.
When light from the Divine appears, falsities and evils are removed; and, when they are removed, there is access for truth and good...
That the sensuous things of the external Natural were removed. Signified, Explained.
For the Holy proceeding... removes falsities and evils...
The previous forms, in man, are not destroyed, but removed.
Elevation by the Lord actually takes place, and thence removal from evils and falsities.
The removal of the falsities which endeavour to destroy the life of truth and good. Signified, Explained.
The removal of filthy loves, and thereby the laying bare of what is internal. Signified, Explained.
To remove (the frogs) () = not to be compelled.
The removal of the appearance of truth Divine with them. Signified, Explained.
Heaven removed itself from man.
Separation and removal from truths. Signified.
Then good removes evil...
Sins are not removed from man except by a life according to the precepts of faith... and, in proportion as they are removed, they are remitted.
That this falsity must be completely removed. Signified, Explained.
For it can be removed, but not blotted out.
Therefore, when evil is removed, good is received.
For evils and falsities must be removed, before truth and good can be received; (and they) are removed through the truths of faith...
Removal from internal things. Signified, Explained.
A great gulf = removal itself from good.
Man cannot be delivered from damnation except by the removal of evil; and the removal of evil is not effected except by actual repentance.
The removal (of good and truth from the middle). Signified, Explained.
To cease from removing (the burden from the neighbour's donkey) () = no removal from falsity by amendment; thus no reception of truth by which is amendment, or removal.
Removing thou shalt remove with him () = exhortation and effort of amendment.
I will remove disease from the midst of thee () = protection from falsifications... For when the Lord protects from them, He removes them.
From those in truths from good (there), falsities are removed; and from those in falsities from evil, truths are removed.
No hasty removal of (falsities from evils). Signified, Explained.
Removal by degrees according to order. Signified. AC 9336. Signified, Explained.
To drive out = removal; for the falsities and evils with man are not expelled, but are removed. Explained.

Whatever man... thinks, wills, speaks, and does, adds itself to his life... these things cannot be exterminated, but only removed; and, when they are being removed, the man appears to be devoid of sins, because they have been removed.
In this and the following verse it treats of this removal.
That falsities from these loves rush in through the hasty removal of evils and falsities, Signified, Explained.
For falsities are not removed except by truths, and evils except by goods...
That removal from evils and falsities is effected according to the increase of good. Signified, Explained.
The staves shall not be removed () = existence and subsistence in perpetuity and without change.
Thence the removal of falsities and evils with those who are in good from the Lord. Signified, Explained.
The Hells dominate over man in proportion as the Lord does not remove them; and He removes them in proportion as man desists from evils.
To bear sins = the removal of evils and falsities from those in good... for, in proportion as the Hells are removed from man, evils and falsities are removed.
The chief work of Salvation is to redeem... man from the Hells, and thus to remove evils and falsities.

It is said to remove evils and falsities, because deliverance from sins... is nothing else than removal; for they remain with the man. But in proportion as the good of love and truth of faith are implanted, evil and falsity are removed. (So) Heaven does not extinguish Hell, but removes from itself those there; for it is the good and truth which are from the Lord... which remove them. So with man, ... in proportion as he is made a Heaven, Hell is removed.
It is the general opinion that evils... are not thus removed, but are completely separated. Explained.

To bear iniquities, when said of the Lord, = to continually fight for man against the Hells, thus continually to remove them; for there is a perpetual removal, not only when the man is in the world, but also in the other life. No man can remove evils in this way: from himself man cannot remove the least of evil, still less the Hells...
Worships representative of removal from sins. Signified, Explained.
In proportion as the good of love and faith enters... sins are removed; that is, Hell is removed, both that within him and that without him.
These are what expiate, that is, remove sins; and, when they have been removed, they appear as if completely removed or taken away.
When man has been purified from evils and falsities, which is effected by the removal of them... AC 10057:6, References.
The continual removal of evils and the derivative falsities... by the good of innocence. Signified, Explained. AC 10134. AC 10135.
The evils and falsities with man are not cast out, but are only removed.
Therefore, in proportion as evil is removed, falsities are removed.
To propitiate = purification from evils and falsities, or, what is the same, the removal of them.
The perpetual removal of evils. Signified, Explained.
In proportion as goods affect man, evils are removed; thus he is purified and delivered from them.
To remove evils by means of truths. Signified, Explained.
The removal of evil and its falsity so that it does not appear. Signified, Explained.
That the interiors (of that nation) may be removed. Signified, Explained.
The removal, then, of evils and falsities thence. Signified, Explained.
To drive out from the faces = to remove from the interiors. AC 10674.
Man has removed himself from Heaven by...
So remote there...
Removals are dissimilitudes.
The Lord then removes these evils.
He removes himself from Heaven.
Evils cannot be removed unless the man sees them in himself... and at last is averse to them: then, first, are they removed.
This proprium (with the Angels) is only removed...
Hence in proportion as evil is removed, the Lord is in them.
Then the love of evil is removed.
Confirmations of evil and falsity are removals of good and truth; for evil removes good, and falsity, truth.
Man must as of himself remove evils... and, in proportion as he removes them, the Lord draws nearer... Signified. DP 33:4.
(What has once been appropriated) can be removed, but not cast out; and, when being removed, it is transferred as from the centre to the circumferences, and there stays.
These goods... then remove evils towards the circumferences...

That... man must as of himself remove evils as sins in the external man, and... the Lord then can remove evils in the internal man, and at the same time in the external. General article. DP 102. DP 111. DP 114. DP 123.
(Such) cannot remove evils as sins...
None of (these evils) can be removed except (in freedom), so that man may remove them as of himself...
(Good cannot be implanted until evil is removed.) Explained. DP 233:4.
a. If evil is not removed in the world, it cannot be removed afterwards.
That evils cannot be removed, unless they appear. General article. DP 278. a.[6], Explained.
a. 5. With such, sins do not appear, and therefore cannot be removed. Explained.
Under Remit, see this reference. DP 280. TCR 539. TCR 611. TCR 614.

As evils are not separated, but only removed, that is, relegated to the sides, and as man can be transferred from the middle... it is possible for him... to return into his evils... From experience. DP 283:2.

Although evils have been removed to the sides, if they look upwards they have still not been removed, because they are still striving to return to the middle. They look downwards when the man shuns his evils as sins... because he then condemns them to Hell.
If (in this fermentation) good conquers, evil with its falsity is removed to the sides... But, if evil conquers, good with its truth is removed to the sides...

The Lord cannot be conjoined with them unless the delights of these evils are removed; and these cannot be removed by the Lord, unless the man explores himself... acknowledges his evils before the Lord, and wills to desist from them...
In proportion, therefore, as evils with their delights are thus removed, the Lord's love enters... and man is led away from Hell into Heaven.
(Thus) it is necessary that evils be first removed, before he can will goods... Illustrated. TCR 331, By comparisons.
That... unless man removes (hereditary) evils as to a part... he remains in them. General article.
Effected by removals of lower things.
The removal of falsities thereby. Signified, Explained.
For evils with man, Spirit, and Angel are not taken away, but removed... AE 478, Explained.
From the man being prepared from Heaven, evils are removed; from him being prepared for Hell, goods are removed; and all the removals take place as from them.
